title_en: Auto-updating spreadsheet feeds for the UP Mandi dashboard
title_hi: यूपी मंडी डैशबोर्ड की स्वतः-अपडेट स्प्रेडशीट फीड
usage_google_sheets: Paste the google_sheets_formula of any sheet into cell A1 of a Google Sheet. Sheets re-fetches IMPORTDATA roughly every hour and on every file open.
usage_excel: Excel: Data -> From Web -> paste csv_url -> Load, then Query Properties -> Refresh every N minutes / Refresh data when opening.
policy: Every cell is copied from an official government snapshot. No simulated prices, arrivals or contacts are generated.

sheets.excel_power_query:
let
    Source = Csv.Document(Web.Contents("https://abhishekagrahari307-max.github.io/mandi/data/sheets/mandi_prices.csv"),
        [Delimiter = ",", Encoding = 65001, QuoteStyle = QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Promoted = Table.PromoteHeaders(Source, [PromoteAllScalars = true])
in
    Promoted
